reason: Docutils HTML5 writer promotes the document title and the single top-level section out of the body fragment (document-title promotion); Markup++ emits the full nested section structure in the fragment. Structural, documented profile difference; heading depth is preserved.

Same document-title promotion as 'sections': the title and top-level section are document structure, not fragment body, in the Docutils HTML5 reference; Markup++ emits them in the fragment. Also the code directive renders without the Docutils inner <code> wrapper.

Docutils HTML5 writer moves bibliographic field lists (Author, Version, ...) into the document <header> docinfo, leaving the fragment empty; Markup++ renders the field list inline as <dl class="field-list">.

Docutils HTML5 emits the footnote-list container, brackets and backlinks structure; Markup++ emits a single <aside class="footnote"> per footnote. Container decoration difference; the footnote target and label text match.
The :math: role is rendered by Docutils as MathML ( with //), while Markup++ emits text; MathML output is not part of the declared Markup++ profile. All other roles in the case match.

File insertion is disabled in the documented profile (settings.file_insertion_enabled=false). Docutils emits an in-fragment system-message aside; Markup++ emits a converter diagnostic and produces no fragment output.

Raw directives are disabled in the documented profile (settings.raw_enabled=false). Docutils emits an in-fragment system-message aside; Markup++ emits a converter diagnostic and produces no fragment output.
